spellbook.finance/limitations: Backend Investor access and workspace membership are required. Missing and inaccessible Item IDs are indistinguishable within the selected scope.

Rows and timestamps describe saved SpellBook Finance state, not a fresh provider observation or completion of a new write. providerVerifiedAt, providerQuantity, desiredAskUsd and writeCompletionCorrelation are unavailable.
A missing channel row does not establish that the provider has no listing. External IDs can identify a pooled listing across copies; do not infer provider quantity from Item counts.

description: Read recorded channel state, asks and saved timestamps for exact inventory copies after a listing or sync action. Returns missing evidence alongside saved facts. A saved live row does not establish completion of a new write. Use the returned job's status tool to check that job's completion.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

itemIds.description: Exact physical Item IDs from inventory discovery or a listing/sync result. Required; at most 100 IDs and 6,000 URI-encoded selector characters. Send smaller batches when needed.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the inventory copies. Required.
